Topic.label: Synthesis and Practice: Music and Mathematics

Question: The product of string length and frequency is constant. How does the frequency change when the string length is halved? (How many times the original frequency does it become? Write only the number.)
Solution: The string length $L$ and frequency $f$ satisfy $L\times f=\text{constant}$. When $L$ becomes $1/2$ of its original value, $f$ becomes 2 times its original value.
